# Sonos favorites

Play a Sonos favourite directly from a list on the dashboard.

## Required Home Assistant integration

The widget needs the **[Sonos integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sonos/)** for the player and its favorites sensor (`sensor.sonos_favorites`) as the list source.

## Configure in the editor

1. Open a page in the [web editor](../editor.md#layout-workspace) and add **Sonos favorites**.
2. Use **Search** beside the entity field to choose an entity by name. Configure its options below.
3. Resize the widget for its content, then **Save** the layout. Try its controls on the panel.

Assign the target media player and the Sonos favourites sensor as the list source.

## Entities and interaction

**Supported primary entities:** `media_player.*`

| Setting / behaviour | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Extras | secondary entity: sensor.sonos_favorites, rendered as the list of favorite rows itself (one or two columns by name length), not a sub-label |
| Interaction | tapping a favorite plays it directly (the player's play action), no popup |

## Layout limits

- Minimum: **280 × 240 px**.
- Maximum: **dashboard width × dashboard height**, capped by the selected display device's dashboard area.
- Leave space for the value, title and touch controls; the minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size.

The [display device overview](../choose-display.md) lists usable dashboard geometry. [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains title/content spacing and touch targets.
